# x += k (T - x) once per logic pass, k a constant (finding 136): at 120 fps these settled twice
# as fast per second. scripts/fps_patch.py gives the multiply e = (T - x) k the rate 1 - (1 - k)^f (f = the 60 Hz frames
# of this update when the site also ran in the previous one, else 1: the stock k), i.e. T + (x - T)(1 - k)^f.
# Found by form in our lifted C (x loaded from the stored field, d = T - x, e = d k, y = x + e, stored back; no call and
# no write of the base register in between) and read one by one: all 48 approach a target (0, 1.0, 2.0, -6, a field).
#
# <function> <store label> <multiply label> <k register> <k> <field>
